hero.imageAlt: Candidate reviewing tailored job matches on a laptop
hero.lede: Upload your resume. We build your career profile, find the jobs you are best positioned for, tailor each application, and help you apply efficiently — without inventing experience.
hero.finePrint: Your resume stays under your control. Free to start.
hero.aiCard: AI is finding and applying to jobs for you...

items.title: You stay in control
items.text: Review or delete your profile and resume data anytime.

items.title: No invented credentials
items.text: Applications use verified facts from your Fact Ledger.

items.title: Sensitive answers wait
items.text: Salary, sponsorship, and EEO fields stay blank until you confirm.

items.title: Review before send
items.text: Assisted Apply prepares; you approve what goes out.

how.title: From resume to ready application in four steps.

steps.title: 1. Upload resume
steps.text: AI drafts your account, Fact Ledger, and Master Career Profile.

steps.title: 2. Find better fits
steps.text: Jobs are scored against verified experience, not keyword stuffing.

steps.title: 3. Tailor & prepare
steps.text: Resume and answers are shaped for the role using only confirmed facts.

steps.title: 4. Review & apply
steps.text: You approve. Assisted fill handles repetition. Every send is tracked.

fit.title: Spend time on roles worth pursuing.
fit.lede: Quality over volume. JobPilot shows why a role fits, what is missing, and when to skip.

efficiency.title: Automation that stops for review.
efficiency.lede: Matched → resume ready → application prepared → you review → submitted. Sensitive questions never auto-answer.

better.title: Stronger wording. Same facts.
better.lede: Upscale improves presentation after clarification — it never invents employers, metrics, or credentials.
better.before: Worked on activation and partnered with design on experiments.
better.after: Owned activation roadmap; partnered with design and used SQL to judge experiments that raised signup completion.

results.title: More qualified applications per hour.
results.lede: Example dashboard once your search is running — real metrics replace placeholders after you activate.
